# Pull Request

> Please read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) before submitting — we do not review resumes or conduct interviews; **PRs are the only way we evaluate contributors**. A great PR = solving a real problem + explaining the rationale + responding to review feedback.

## PR Type

Please follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) for the PR title (e.g., `fix: fix xxx` / `feat: add xxx`).

- [ ] 🐛 Bug Fix (fix)
- [ ] 🌟 New Feature (feat)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation (docs)
- [ ] 🧹 Refactoring (refactor)
- [ ] ⚡ Performance Optimization (perf)
- [ ] 🧪 Tests (test)
- [ ] 🔧 Build / Chore (chore)

## Compliance Red-Line Checklist

This project is positioned as a research assistance tool. Please confirm each item:

- [ ] Does not introduce trading instruction features such as target prices, stop-loss/take-profit levels, or buy/sell timing
- [ ] Does not remove or weaken compliance disclaimers such as "does not constitute investment advice"
- [ ] Does not scrape data sources requiring login/payment, and does not bypass platform anti-scraping restrictions
- [ ] Contains no hardcoded secrets or sensitive information
